# Typed CSV owner composition

This disposable CI fixture composes the exact candidate Onboarding compiler and
validator, Ingestion compatibility/parser/pipeline/PG outbox, and UDP durable
intake/governed identity/index/materializer/PG readback. Two deliberately new
acquisitions use the same approved configuration and CSV. The oracle requires one
canonical object and revision, two observations and retained provenance, and exact
numeric/date values and published datatype IRIs.

Semantic publication/HUMAN assertions and Data Lake object storage are synthetic
fixture ports. There is no Gateway/Authorization/THS/provider acceptance or live
outbox delivery ACK/watermark proof here. Explicit migrations only bootstrap this
isolated CI database; they are not rollout/startup code. No target calls, existing
claims, historical CSV, installation bindings, or runtime authority are used.

A PASS qualifies this WP5 typed owner-contract composition only. It does not close
G5 (vocabulary/relationship cases remain), F5/F6, or general CSV E2E acceptance.
